messages:
alex: paging: seeing sustained 5xx spike in apac-east-1. p95 latency ~900ms, error rate ~12%. auto-alert fired. Anyone oncall?

sre-bot: Incident created INC-20260305-4215. Paging @maria (oncall) and @kai.

maria: I'm on it, starting triage. Any recent deploys or config pushes?

alex: nothing obvious in deploy logs. Errors started ~04:03UTC. Traffic shows a sharp increase to apac cluster.

kai: pulling node logs. Observing repeated OOMs on inference-runner-2 and GPU driver restarts.

maria: ok. I'm going to start a graceful traffic shift: drain apac-east-1 to 60% and move ~40% to eu-west-1 to reduce tail pressure.

maria: running reroute command now:
```
routerctl set-weight --from apac-east-1 --to eu-west-1 --weight 0.4 --reason "incident apac-5xx"
```

jon: also recommend enforcing a soft per-tenant rate cap to curb retry storms. propose 20rps/customer in apac for 30m.

maria: applying soft quota overrides for top apac tenants:
```
quotactl override --region apac-east-1 --tenant-file /tmp/top-ten-apac.json --max-rps 20 --duration 30m
```

prod-sup: notifying affected customers in apac now. messaging: "experiencing degraded responses; mitigation in progress; credits offered".

kai: adding a shaping rule to restrict heavy-context model variants in apac to avoid memory pressure:
```
policyctl patch apac-east-1 --disable-model-variant heavy-context --duration 45m --reason "reduce OOMs"
```

alex: deploy-bot: any auto-rollbacks or canary events? we didn't push anything but checking.

deploy-bot: No recent canary failures reported in apac within the last hour.

maria: looks hardware-linked (noisy GPU host). Initiating partial brownout: reduce max_tokens to 512 and disable non-critical features in apac.

maria: config command:
```
configctl set apac-east-1 request.max_tokens 512 --who maria --note "incident mitigation"
```

sre-bot: Note: @maria (oncall) assumed ownership at 1779998888. Mitigations logged.

jon: metrics after reroute + quotas: 5xx down to ~4%, p95 latency ~420ms, token throughput reduced ~30%.

maria: good improvement. still seeing 502s for a small bucket of tenant ids — putting those into quarantine and routing to low-priority queue so they don't amplify failures.

prod-sup: 3 paid customers reported degraded UI behavior; confirmed outreach and credits. one has a real-time SLA, tracking separately.

kai: opened cloud provider ticket for host OOMs: gcloud case #123456 (apac-east-1). kernel OOM traces attached.

maria: If errors don't continue to fall, plan B is full regional failover (drain to 0) and shift to apac-backup or alternate provider. Preparing runbook steps now.

alex: handoff in ~25m to @jon for monitoring. Please document the exact timing of quota overrides and reroute for post-incident notes.

jon: taking lap. I'll monitor logs/alerts and coordinate with infra-team if kernel OOMs persist. keeping runbook pinned.

sre-bot: Incident updated: mitigations applied: reroute 40% -> eu-west-1, quota overrides active, heavy-context variant disabled, max_tokens lowered.

maria: leaving mitigations active for 20 more minutes, then reassess. thanks all :thumbsup:

end
